breakdown.description: For an intrinsic semiconductor, n = p = n_i; the listed carrier concentrations cannot greatly exceed the stated n_i without doping.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification completely omits the erroneous claim that n = p = 1.0×10²⁰ m⁻³ without doping. Instead, it correctly treats n_i (and hence n = p = n_i) as a single quantity to be calculated from the standard intrinsic semiconductor formula, consistent with the ground truth which only references n_i = 1.0×10¹⁶ m⁻³ as the starting point and asks for the correct intrinsic carrier concentration.
